content: If you miss a dose of your medication, take it as soon as you remember. However, if it is close to the time of your next scheduled dose, skip the missed dose and proceed with your next dose at the regular time. Do not double the dose to make up for the missed one. Store this medication at room temperature, ensuring it is kept away from light and moisture. Do not store it in the bathroom, as the humidity can affect the medication's stability. Avoid flushing medications down the toilet or pouring them into a drain unless specifically instructed to do so. When the medication is expired or no longer needed, dispose of it properly to prevent harm to others or the environment. Taking expired demeclocycline can lead to serious health complications.
